item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A relatively dry continental airstream will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of southern China during the weekend. The continental airstream will be replaced by a southerly airstream early next week. There will be a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the Philippines will move across Luzon in the next couple of days and weaken gradually.
